title: Count Pairs Of Similar Strings
summary: Given a string array, count pairs of strings that consist of the same characters.
statement: Given a string array, count pairs of strings that consist of the same characters. For example, 'abca' and 'cba' are similar, but 'abacba' and 'bcfd' are not. Count pairs (i, j) where 0 <= i < j <= word.length - 1 and words[i] and words[j] are similar.
constraints: Two strings are similar when they contain exactly the same set of distinct letters.
Letter multiplicities and order do not matter.
Count index pairs i<j of similar strings.
hints: Canonicalize each word as its set of distinct letters.
Use that immutable set as a hash-map key.
For each word, add the number of earlier identical keys before incrementing its frequency.
Every similar pair is counted once when its later endpoint is processed.
editorial: Every similar pair is counted once when its later endpoint is processed.

tests.explanation: aba pairs with aabb, while bac pairs with aabc; those are the two similar pairs.
All three strings share letter set {a,b}, so all three index pairs qualify.
